title: Smartphone Cracked Glass, Digitizer Functionality, and Display Replacement
symptoms: Front glass cracked or shattered like spiderweb
Touch digitizer still registers finger taps accurately
OLED or LCD underneath is intact without black ink spots or vertical lines
No loose glass shards penetrating fingers

pathway_suitability.continue_using: High suitability if protected with a tempered glass screen protector or clear tape overlay to seal fragments.
pathway_suitability.repair: High suitability. Screen assembly replacement restores cosmetic integrity and water resistance.
pathway_suitability.reuse: Viable resale as 'cracked glass / functional' with appropriate 40-50% discount.
pathway_suitability.donate: Acceptable for emergency phone programs (e.g. 911/shelter phones) if touchscreen works.
pathway_suitability.repurpose: Outstanding candidate for stationary home security camera (Alfred Camera), dedicated in-car GPS/dashcam, or wireless Spotify streaming receiver.
pathway_suitability.recycle: Premature if display and motherboard remain operational.

repair_considerations: Modular screen replacements are widely supported with aftermarket kits ($25-$60) for popular brands. Heat gun or iOpener needed to soften perimeter adhesive. Intermediate DIY skill required.
reuse_possibilities: Full smartphone features remain usable; screen protector prevents further crack propagation.
donation_considerations: Many domestic violence shelters and homeless outreach organizations accept functional cracked smartphones for emergency communications.
repurposing_possibilities: High-definition webcam (using Camo / DroidCam), baby monitor, 3D printer remote monitoring camera (OctoPrint/Klipper), smart home wall-mounted dashboard.
recycling_considerations: Recycle through manufacturer take-back or certified e-waste recycler if frame is twisted or logic board is damaged.
safety_limitations: Micro-shards of glass can shed; apply transparent adhesive film or screen protector immediately before handling.
evidence_text: Smartphone screens represent up to 30% of total device manufacturing carbon emissions and raw material costs. According to the Restart Project, over 65% of prematurely discarded smartphones have broken screens as their sole defect while processors and memory are fully operational. Installing a tempered glass protector over hair-line fractures or replacing the modular panel prevents the manufacturing footprint of a replacement device.
source: The Restart Project & iFixit Smartphone Repairability Benchmarks
source_name: The Restart Project & iFixit Smartphone Repairability Benchmarks

title: Smartphone Battery Depletion vs. Dangerous Cell Swelling and Thermal Runaway
symptoms: Battery health indicator reports under 80% maximum capacity
Phone shuts off at 20% or in cold weather
Rear glass or display screen is pushed outward or popped open by bulging battery
Sweet chemical acetone-like odor or localized heat while charging

pathway_suitability.repair: High suitability for normal degradation (under 80% health). CAUTION: Swollen battery requires immediate trained disposal or careful specialized technician removal.
pathway_suitability.continue_using: Normal degraded battery can be used with a portable power bank. SWOLLEN BATTERY MUST NOT BE USED OR CHARGED.
pathway_suitability.reuse: Normal battery can be resold with disclosure. Swollen battery MUST NOT be shipped or resold.
pathway_suitability.donate: Charities reject phones with swollen batteries due to insurance and fire regulations.
pathway_suitability.repurpose: Can only be repurposed if swollen battery is safely extracted and device can run battery-less on 5V bypass (some models require dummy battery simulator).
pathway_suitability.recycle: MANDATORY immediate e-waste / hazardous waste processing for swollen or punctured cells.

repair_considerations: Normal battery replacement: $15-$30 replacement kit. Swollen battery: Do not bend or use metal pry tools. Use blunt plastic picks and isopropyl alcohol to soften pull-tabs. Work outdoors or in ventilated area away from combustibles.
reuse_possibilities: Power bank tethering extends normal battery phones by 1-2 years.
donation_considerations: Only donate after battery replacement or if phone holds at least 3 hours screen-on time.
repurposing_possibilities: Permanent plugged-in sensor or audio gateway (after battery removal/bypass).
recycling_considerations: Place swollen battery in sand bucket or metal container. Deliver to hazardous waste e-waste depot. NEVER dispose in curb recycling or trash.
safety_limitations: CRITICAL HAZARD: Thermal runaway risk. Puncturing a swollen pouch cell produces violent jet fires exceeding 600°C and toxic hydrofluoric gas fumes.
evidence_text: US Consumer Product Safety Commission (CPSC) and battery safety science confirm that lithium-ion pouch cells accumulate gas (hydrocarbons, carbon dioxide, hydrogen) during internal short-circuiting or electrolyte breakdown. While standard capacity drop is a normal electrochemical aging process solved via simple modular cell swap, swelling denotes structural breakdown requiring strict containment.
source: US Consumer Product Safety Commission (CPSC) & Battery University Guidelines
source_name: US Consumer Product Safety Commission (CPSC) & Battery University

title: Smartphone Software Deprecation, Banking App Incompatibility, and Repurposing
symptoms: Device no longer receives Android security patches or iOS updates
Banking, payment, and sensitive financial apps refuse to launch
Hardware (camera, GPS, display, speakers, cellular radio) is physically flawless
Sluggish app loading under newer bloated frameworks

pathway_suitability.repurpose: OUTSTANDING PRIMARY PATHWAY. Device retains exceptional compute, sensor, and optical capabilities for non-banking single-purpose tasks.
pathway_suitability.continue_using: Acceptable for secondary non-financial uses (music streaming, e-reading, navigation, offline GPS).
pathway_suitability.repair: Not applicable (software/firmware limitation). Custom ROM (LineageOS) installation can provide modern Android versions on supported Qualcomm models.
pathway_suitability.reuse: Can be gifted to children for offline games, music, or Wi-Fi educational apps.
pathway_suitability.donate: Viable for wildlife tracking acoustic monitors, community tool libraries, or digital art displays.
pathway_suitability.recycle: LAST RESORT ONLY. Discarding mint hardware due to cloud API obsolescence wastes pristine rare earth minerals.

repair_considerations: Custom ROM flashing requires unlocked bootloader, basic command line familiarity (fastboot/adb), and 1 hour of setup. Restores modern security patch level.
reuse_possibilities: Offline audio player, high-resolution alarm clock, dedicated kitchen recipe viewer.
donation_considerations: Acceptable for organizations that do not require enterprise MDM management.
repurposing_possibilities: 1. High-fidelity wireless audio streamer connected to vintage stereo; 2. Dedicated smart home thermostat/lighting control pad; 3. Wildlife bioacoustic monitoring device; 4. Vehicle telematics / offline Maps gateway.
recycling_considerations: If recycling is chosen, perform factory cryptographic data wipe first.
safety_limitations: Do not conduct sensitive banking or primary email operations on devices lacking modern TLS 1.3 and security patch updates.
evidence_text: Smartphones contain upwards of 40 individual elements including neodymium magnets, tantalum capacitors, cobalt cathodes, and gold-plated connectors. When smartphone manufacturers end software security support after 3-5 years, the physical durability of the device remains virtually intact. The Ellen MacArthur Foundation emphasizes functional cascading (repurposing) as the premier mechanism to retain embodied product value without recycling destruction.
source: Ellen MacArthur Foundation & European Circular Economy Stakeholder Platform
source_name: Ellen MacArthur Foundation Circular Electronics Case Study

title: Tablet and iPad Touch Digitizer, Secondary Display, and Educational Kiosk Use
symptoms: Tablet has large 9 to 12-inch display with minor hairline glass crack or scratch
Touch response works smoothly across 100% of panel
User upgraded to newer model and has no primary travel need for old tablet

pathway_suitability.repurpose: OUTSTANDING PRIMARY PATHWAY. Deploy as secondary PC monitor (via Spacedesk/Duet), digital kitchen recipe station, smart sheet-music reader, or home assistant dashboard.
pathway_suitability.continue_using: High suitability for media consumption, PDF reading, and streaming at home on coffee table or bedside stand.
pathway_suitability.reuse: High demand in family circles for children's entertainment or drawing.
pathway_suitability.donate: Highly sought after by pediatric wards, community art centers, and adult literacy centers.
pathway_suitability.repair: Feasible screen replacement ($35-$70) if glass is actively shedding shards.
pathway_suitability.recycle: Premature. The large display panel and battery retain substantial home utility.

repair_considerations: Tablets use extensive perimeter adhesive. Soften with heating pad or hair dryer before prying. Digitizer glass is often separate from LCD on budget models, keeping repair costs low.
reuse_possibilities: Desktop extended monitor, digital photo slideshow frame, kitchen cooking companion.
donation_considerations: Ensure passcode lock and iCloud/Google accounts are completely unbound before donation.
repurposing_possibilities: 1. Home automation touch panel mounted to wall; 2. Secondary display for laptop via Wi-Fi; 3. Dedicated digital piano sheet music display.
recycling_considerations: Extract Li-ion battery before metal chassis shredding at e-waste depot.
safety_limitations: Ensure adhesive does not pull on fragile ribbon cables during disassembly.
evidence_text: Consumer electronics lifecycle studies indicate that tablets have longer secondary life potentials than smartphones due to their larger screen real-estate and indoor-dominated usage profiles. Even with degraded batteries, stationary wall-plugged kiosk roles extend functional lifespan by an additional 4 to 6 years without virgin manufacturing impacts.
source: Electronics Eco-Design Observatory & Circular Hardware Consortium
source_name: Electronics Eco-Design Observatory & Circular Hardware Consortium
